name: Omniview View Volume Control
definition: A user interface technique using a mouse tracking window and joystick to control the position and size (radius) of the 3D view volume displayed in the Omniview device.
summary: Omniview View Volume Control is a direct manipulation interface using a mouse tracking window and joystick to control 3D view volume position, size, and data value, offering immersive interaction compared to indirect WIMP systems.
